technical.summary: Early momentum signals (stoch/RSI crosses) show potential reversal setup, but price remains structurally weak below all key moving averages with negative MACD and weak trend confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 77 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market conditions present contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 1 small sale) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (397.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and macro_score of -6 create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 77 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic RSI cross-up and supertrend bullish signals in extreme fear conditions (VIX 397.6) present classic contrarian reversal setup near support at 102.95.
debate.key_bear_argument: Structural weakness (price below all major moving averages, negative MACD, below VWAP, weak ADX) combined with crisis macro environment (FOMC today, flat yield curve, rising dollar), zero smart money conviction, and high earnings risk in 77 days make this a low-probability entry despite momentum crosses.
